No shard artifact was uploaded and the pandas-df and datafusion-df job logs are unavailable, so the failing cell is unknown. Reproduce each shard's cell order, measure peak memory per cell, and either bring the cells within the runner or take an envelope or runner-size change to the owner (paid or larger runners need owner approval).
